description: UNOSAT and partner damage assessments: Syria is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code EQ20230206SYR, GDACS Id: 1357372 This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the 6th of February 2023 earthquake in Al Bab and in Al Bab district (Aleppo governorate), Syria as detected from a Pleiades very high resolution satellite image acquired on 11 February 2023. Coverage: Syria. The portal lists 73 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are earthquake-tsunami, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2023-03-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency shelter and critical facility planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
